name: triage
title: Sort a support ticket and draft a reply

origin.source: Extracted from the AI SDK host demo in this repository

comparison.purpose: Classifies an incoming ticket, escalates to a human when the classifier is unsure, drafts the reply that fits, and retries once if the draft fails.
